title: Lead Software Engineer - AI
description:
Lead Software Engineer - AI



Job-Specific Responsibilities:

  • Develop production-ready software solutions that solve real business problems, considering business needs and technology/operations landscape; lead interaction with internal stakeholders and technology on specific projects and initiatives
  • Apply software engineering, data science, machine learning, and AI techniques to derive business value from the full range of internal and external data, leveraging Cloud-based technology
  • Design solutions, build initial code, and provide documentation with ways of working to minimize time to value and maximize re-usability
  • Translate complex data and methodology into strategic, operationally feasible insights and recommendations; automate implementation
  • Communicate clearly and effectively to technical and non-technical audiences, verbally and visually, to create understanding, engagement, and buy-in
  • Identify trends and opportunities to drive innovation, both in what we do and how we do it; evaluate new software engineering, data science, machine learning, and AI technologies and tools that can boost team performance, innovation, and business value
  • Manage, coach, and mentor a team of software engineers and data scientists, serving as a predominant technical expert
  • Actively contribute to and re-use community best practices
  • Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents.
  • This role is responsible for other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum of seven years’ post-secondary education or relevant work experience

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

Required skills

  • Bachelor’s/Advanced Degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or 7+ years equivalent work experience
  • 3-5 years of experience in developing a variety of software products in a commercial environment
  • 2+ years of experience in building generative AI-based products.
  • Strong Python and Typescript/JavaScript skills required;
  • Expertise in multivariate statistical modelling (e.g., clustering, regression, principal components and factor analysis, time-series forecasting, Bayesian methods) and modern machine learning (ensemble methods, regularization, gradient boosting, representation learning, deep neural networks, transformers architectures, self-supervised learning, and MLOps fundamentals) required
  • Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, GCP, or other), or equivalent on-premise platform
  • Experience working in agile methodology is required
  • Prior experience in leading data science and machine learning based software development projects focused on solving business problems and seizing business opportunities

Desired skills

  • Proficiency in SQL desirable
  • Ability to mentor and lead others; provide hands-on technical guidance; conduct code reviews
  • Ability to simultaneously coordinate and track multiple deliverables, tasks, and dependencies across multiple stakeholders / business areas
  • Experience with deep learning and neural network architectures (e.g., CNNs, RNNs, transformers), including generative and self-supervised models, and with frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch is desirable.

Proficiency with data visualization tools is desirable

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office


Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

title: SAP S/4 HANA Finance Application Expert (Experto en aplicaciones financieras de SAP S/4 HANA)
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.


Primary Job Purpose

Manage, support, and assist in the design and implementation of the Financial Accounting and

Controlling template including configurations and determining the best ways to use S/4 HANA by

merging business and IT needs, and focusing on utilizing the system for the greatest efficiency and

utilization.


Key Position Accountabilities

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP FICO (Financial Accounting and Controlling) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Lead and support the Finance Area in the SAP implementation project from an IT perspective and ensure timely completion of related project activities with key focus on quality.
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Analyse, create and document business processes during the project implementation.
  • Support larger project team during configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and up-grade phases.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in FICO in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects.
  • Should have a strong integration knowledge between FI-SD, FI-MM, FI-PP
  • Should have a strong knowledge Bank master setup, electronic bank statement (EBS) configuration, and cash management.
  • Proven experience in design, concept, principles, and configuration in SAP FICO area.
  • Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously (implementations, enhancements of ERP templates etc.)


SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in FICO in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects with a minimum experience of 5 years.
  • Proven experience in design, concept, principles, and configuration in SAP FICO area.
  • Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously (implementations, enhancements of ERP templates etc.)
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline.

Desirable:

  • SAP Certification in SAP Financial Accounting/Controlling.

WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.


We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.


FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.


We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.

  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms

  • Feature adoption

  • Customer retention and engagement

Sales Analytics

  • Pipeline performance
  • Conversion rates
  • Sales cycle length
  • Revenue forecasting

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data analysis .

  • Strong understanding of SaaS metrics and revenue models .
  • Proven ability to translate data into clear insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Experience building dashboards and analytics systems.


Skills:

Experience with several of the following tools is preferred:

  • BI and analytics platforms (Looker, Tableau, Metabase, Power BI, etc.)
  • SQL and data querying
  • Data visualization and dashboard creation
  • CRM analytics (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar)
  • Marketing analytics platforms
  • Product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar)


Key Qualities

  • Highly analytical and detail-oriented
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights
  • Strong communication skills
  • Proactive mindset and ownership of results


What Success Looks Like in This Role

  • Leadership has clear visibility into company performance at all times .
  • Key dashboards track the company’s most important metrics.
  • Data insights lead to better strategic decisions and faster growth .
  • The organization becomes increasingly data-driven in how it operates .

title: Lead Software Engineer - AI
description:
Lead Software Engineer - AI



Job-Specific Responsibilities:

  • Develop production-ready software solutions that solve real business problems, considering business needs and technology/operations landscape; lead interaction with internal stakeholders and technology on specific projects and initiatives
  • Apply software engineering, data science, machine learning, and AI techniques to derive business value from the full range of internal and external data, leveraging Cloud-based technology
  • Design solutions, build initial code, and provide documentation with ways of working to minimize time to value and maximize re-usability
  • Translate complex data and methodology into strategic, operationally feasible insights and recommendations; automate implementation
  • Communicate clearly and effectively to technical and non-technical audiences, verbally and visually, to create understanding, engagement, and buy-in
  • Identify trends and opportunities to drive innovation, both in what we do and how we do it; evaluate new software engineering, data science, machine learning, and AI technologies and tools that can boost team performance, innovation, and business value
  • Manage, coach, and mentor a team of software engineers and data scientists, serving as a predominant technical expert
  • Actively contribute to and re-use community best practices
  • Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents.
  • This role is responsible for other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum of seven years’ post-secondary education or relevant work experience

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

Required skills

  • Bachelor’s/Advanced Degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or 7+ years equivalent work experience
  • 3-5 years of experience in developing a variety of software products in a commercial environment
  • 2+ years of experience in building generative AI-based products.
  • Strong Python and Typescript/JavaScript skills required;
  • Expertise in multivariate statistical modelling (e.g., clustering, regression, principal components and factor analysis, time-series forecasting, Bayesian methods) and modern machine learning (ensemble methods, regularization, gradient boosting, representation learning, deep neural networks, transformers architectures, self-supervised learning, and MLOps fundamentals) required
  • Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, GCP, or other), or equivalent on-premise platform
  • Experience working in agile methodology is required
  • Prior experience in leading data science and machine learning based software development projects focused on solving business problems and seizing business opportunities

Desired skills

  • Proficiency in SQL desirable
  • Ability to mentor and lead others; provide hands-on technical guidance; conduct code reviews
  • Ability to simultaneously coordinate and track multiple deliverables, tasks, and dependencies across multiple stakeholders / business areas
  • Experience with deep learning and neural network architectures (e.g., CNNs, RNNs, transformers), including generative and self-supervised models, and with frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch is desirable.

Proficiency with data visualization tools is desirable

title: Artificial Intelligence Specialist
description:
Especialista Sênior em Agentes de Inteligência Artificial

Data de início: imediata

Tempo de alocação: indeterminado

Horário: 9h00 às 18h00

Idiomas: inglês intermediário


Visão Geral da Posição


Buscamos um(a) Especialista Sênior em Agentes de Inteligência Artificial com perfil altamente técnico e atuação hands-on, capaz de projetar, desenvolver e evoluir agentes autônomos baseados em LLMs. Este(a) profissional será responsável não apenas por interfaces conversacionais, mas principalmente pela construção da lógica de decisão, orquestração de ferramentas, memória, contexto e integração com sistemas corporativos.


A posição exige forte domínio em engenharia de software aplicada à IA, arquitetura de soluções com GenAI e implementação de agentes robustos para ambientes produtivos, com foco em confiabilidade, escalabilidade e geração de valor para o negócio.


Responsabilidades


• Projetar e implementar agentes de IA com lógica de decisão estruturada, uso de ferramentas, memória e controle de fluxo

• Desenvolver arquiteturas baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) para respostas fundamentadas em dados internos

• Integrar LLMs a sistemas corporativos via APIs, bancos de dados, serviços internos e plataformas externas

• Definir estratégias de prompt engineering, avaliação e melhoria contínua de desempenho dos agentes

• Estruturar pipelines de dados para indexação, embeddings e busca vetorial

• Atuar na definição de padrões de arquitetura, qualidade de código e boas práticas de engenharia para soluções de IA

• Trabalhar em conjunto com times de produto, dados e engenharia para transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em agentes

• Apoiar tecnicamente desenvolvedores de níveis pleno e júnior, promovendo evolução técnica do time


Requisitos Obrigatórios


• Perfil sênior hands-on, com capacidade de implementar a lógica interna de agentes além da camada conversacional

• Domínio avançado em Python (preferencial para IA) ou Node.js/TypeScript

• Experiência prática com frameworks de orquestração de agentes como LangChain, LlamaIndex, Agno/PhiData ou CrewAI

• Experiência com bancos de dados vetoriais para busca semântica

• Domínio avançado de técnicas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

• Experiência com integração e ajuste de prompts para LLMs como GPT-4, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, além de modelos open-source como Llama 3 e Mistral

• Experiência com serviços de IA em nuvem como AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI Service ou Google Vertex AI

• Sólidos conhecimentos em APIs RESTful, arquitetura de microserviços e conteinerização com Docker


Requisitos Desejáveis


• Experiência em LLMOps, incluindo monitoramento, rastreabilidade e avaliação de modelos em produção com ferramentas como LangSmith, Arize Phoenix ou Ragas

• Conhecimento em criação de agentes com estado e ciclos utilizando LangGraph

• Experiência prática com fine-tuning de modelos para domínios específicos

• Conhecimento em bancos de dados orientados a grafos como Neo4j para estratégias de GraphRAG

• Experiência com execução de modelos locais utilizando Ollama ou vLLM


Competências Comportamentais e Soft Skills


• Capacidade de traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em arquiteturas de agentes de IA claras e estruturadas

• Pensamento sistêmico para conectar dados, modelos, ferramentas e fluxos de decisão

• Comunicação técnica clara com áreas não técnicas, facilitando alinhamento entre tecnologia e negócio

• Postura colaborativa para atuação em times multidisciplinares

• Proatividade na identificação de melhorias técnicas e oportunidades de uso de IA

• Capacidade de mentoria e referência técnica para profissionais menos experientes

• Organização e disciplina para trabalhar com experimentação contínua sem perder rastreabilidade e governança

• Senso crítico para avaliar riscos, limitações de modelos e impactos éticos das soluções de IA


Diferenciais de Perfil


• Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta escala ou sistemas críticos

• Vivência em times de inovação, P&D ou construção de plataformas de IA do zero

• Forte preocupação com qualidade, observabilidade e confiabilidade de agentes em produção


Maiores detalhes técnicos, de contexto do produto e expectativas do cliente serão apresentados durante a entrevista técnica.

title: Head of Analytics & Business Intelligence
description:
About Warmy :)

Warmy.io enhances email deliverability by optimizing domain and IP reputation, ensuring emails land in inboxes instead of spam folders. Our advanced platform simplifies email warming using a unique email seed list.


With integrations like Google Postmaster Tools, Warmy provides actionable insights for superior email performance. Catering to a global audience, Warmy supports email warming in over 30 languages and offers free tools for marketers, such as the Email Deliverability Test and SPF/DMARC Record Generators. Warmy is designed to streamline email deliverability, allowing users to focus on meaningful audience engagement.


Role Description

We are looking for a Head of Analytics & Business Intelligence to own and manage all company analytics. This role is responsible for building a clear view of the business through data, monitoring key metrics on a daily basis, and translating numbers into actionable insights for leadership.

The ideal candidate is someone who not only builds dashboards but actively tracks performance, identifies trends, and provides clear conclusions and recommendations that help the company make better decisions.

You will work closely with leadership, marketing, product, sales, and customer success to ensure the company operates in a data-driven way .


Responsabilites:

  • Own the company’s analytics strategy and data visibility across all departments.
  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports that track key company metrics.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across all systems.


KPI Monitoring

Continuously track and analyze key business metrics including:

Revenue & Financial Metrics

  • MRR / ARR
  • Revenue growth
  • Churn
  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
  • Expansion revenue

Marketing Performance

  • Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
  • Channel performance
  • Attribution analysis
  • Funnel conversion rates
  • Campaign performance

Product Analytics

  • User activation
  • Feature adoption
  • Product usage trends
  • Customer retention and engagement

Sales Analytics

  • Pipeline performance
  • Conversion rates
  • Sales cycle length
  • Revenue forecasting

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data analysis .
  • Experience working in SaaS or technology companies .
  • Strong understanding of SaaS metrics and revenue models .
  • Proven ability to translate data into clear insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Experience building dashboards and analytics systems.


Skills:

Experience with several of the following tools is preferred:

  • BI and analytics platforms (Looker, Tableau, Metabase, Power BI, etc.)
  • SQL and data querying
  • Data visualization and dashboard creation
  • CRM analytics (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar)
  • Marketing analytics platforms
  • Product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar)


Key Qualities

  • Highly analytical and detail-oriented
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights
  • Strong communication skills
  • Proactive mindset and ownership of results


What Success Looks Like in This Role

  • Leadership has clear visibility into company performance at all times .
  • Key dashboards track the company’s most important metrics.
  • Data insights lead to better strategic decisions and faster growth .
  • The organization becomes increasingly data-driven in how it operates .

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office


Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

title: Artificial Intelligence Specialist
description:
Especialista Sênior em Agentes de Inteligência Artificial

Data de início: imediata

Tempo de alocação: indeterminado

Horário: 9h00 às 18h00

Idiomas: inglês intermediário


Visão Geral da Posição


Buscamos um(a) Especialista Sênior em Agentes de Inteligência Artificial com perfil altamente técnico e atuação hands-on, capaz de projetar, desenvolver e evoluir agentes autônomos baseados em LLMs. Este(a) profissional será responsável não apenas por interfaces conversacionais, mas principalmente pela construção da lógica de decisão, orquestração de ferramentas, memória, contexto e integração com sistemas corporativos.


A posição exige forte domínio em engenharia de software aplicada à IA, arquitetura de soluções com GenAI e implementação de agentes robustos para ambientes produtivos, com foco em confiabilidade, escalabilidade e geração de valor para o negócio.


Responsabilidades


• Projetar e implementar agentes de IA com lógica de decisão estruturada, uso de ferramentas, memória e controle de fluxo

• Desenvolver arquiteturas baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) para respostas fundamentadas em dados internos

• Integrar LLMs a sistemas corporativos via APIs, bancos de dados, serviços internos e plataformas externas

• Definir estratégias de prompt engineering, avaliação e melhoria contínua de desempenho dos agentes

• Estruturar pipelines de dados para indexação, embeddings e busca vetorial

• Atuar na definição de padrões de arquitetura, qualidade de código e boas práticas de engenharia para soluções de IA

• Trabalhar em conjunto com times de produto, dados e engenharia para transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em agentes

• Apoiar tecnicamente desenvolvedores de níveis pleno e júnior, promovendo evolução técnica do time


Requisitos Obrigatórios


• Perfil sênior hands-on, com capacidade de implementar a lógica interna de agentes além da camada conversacional

• Domínio avançado em Python (preferencial para IA) ou Node.js/TypeScript

• Experiência prática com frameworks de orquestração de agentes como LangChain, LlamaIndex, Agno/PhiData ou CrewAI

• Experiência com bancos de dados vetoriais para busca semântica

• Domínio avançado de técnicas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

• Experiência com integração e ajuste de prompts para LLMs como GPT-4, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, além de modelos open-source como Llama 3 e Mistral

• Experiência com serviços de IA em nuvem como AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI Service ou Google Vertex AI

• Sólidos conhecimentos em APIs RESTful, arquitetura de microserviços e conteinerização com Docker


Requisitos Desejáveis


• Experiência em LLMOps, incluindo monitoramento, rastreabilidade e avaliação de modelos em produção com ferramentas como LangSmith, Arize Phoenix ou Ragas

• Conhecimento em criação de agentes com estado e ciclos utilizando LangGraph

• Experiência prática com fine-tuning de modelos para domínios específicos

• Conhecimento em bancos de dados orientados a grafos como Neo4j para estratégias de GraphRAG

• Experiência com execução de modelos locais utilizando Ollama ou vLLM


Competências Comportamentais e Soft Skills


• Capacidade de traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em arquiteturas de agentes de IA claras e estruturadas

• Pensamento sistêmico para conectar dados, modelos, ferramentas e fluxos de decisão

• Comunicação técnica clara com áreas não técnicas, facilitando alinhamento entre tecnologia e negócio

• Postura colaborativa para atuação em times multidisciplinares

• Proatividade na identificação de melhorias técnicas e oportunidades de uso de IA

• Capacidade de mentoria e referência técnica para profissionais menos experientes

• Organização e disciplina para trabalhar com experimentação contínua sem perder rastreabilidade e governança

• Senso crítico para avaliar riscos, limitações de modelos e impactos éticos das soluções de IA


Diferenciais de Perfil


• Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta escala ou sistemas críticos

• Vivência em times de inovação, P&D ou construção de plataformas de IA do zero

• Forte preocupação com qualidade, observabilidade e confiabilidade de agentes em produção


Maiores detalhes técnicos, de contexto do produto e expectativas do cliente serão apresentados durante a entrevista técnica.

title: Artificial Intelligence Specialist
description:
Especialista Sênior em Agentes de Inteligência Artificial

Data de início: imediata

Tempo de alocação: indeterminado

Horário: 9h00 às 18h00

Idiomas: inglês intermediário


Visão Geral da Posição


Buscamos um(a) Especialista Sênior em Agentes de Inteligência Artificial com perfil altamente técnico e atuação hands-on, capaz de projetar, desenvolver e evoluir agentes autônomos baseados em LLMs. Este(a) profissional será responsável não apenas por interfaces conversacionais, mas principalmente pela construção da lógica de decisão, orquestração de ferramentas, memória, contexto e integração com sistemas corporativos.


A posição exige forte domínio em engenharia de software aplicada à IA, arquitetura de soluções com GenAI e implementação de agentes robustos para ambientes produtivos, com foco em confiabilidade, escalabilidade e geração de valor para o negócio.


Responsabilidades


• Projetar e implementar agentes de IA com lógica de decisão estruturada, uso de ferramentas, memória e controle de fluxo

• Desenvolver arquiteturas baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) para respostas fundamentadas em dados internos

• Integrar LLMs a sistemas corporativos via APIs, bancos de dados, serviços internos e plataformas externas

• Definir estratégias de prompt engineering, avaliação e melhoria contínua de desempenho dos agentes

• Estruturar pipelines de dados para indexação, embeddings e busca vetorial

• Atuar na definição de padrões de arquitetura, qualidade de código e boas práticas de engenharia para soluções de IA

• Trabalhar em conjunto com times de produto, dados e engenharia para transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em agentes

• Apoiar tecnicamente desenvolvedores de níveis pleno e júnior, promovendo evolução técnica do time


Requisitos Obrigatórios


• Perfil sênior hands-on, com capacidade de implementar a lógica interna de agentes além da camada conversacional

• Domínio avançado em Python (preferencial para IA) ou Node.js/TypeScript

• Experiência prática com frameworks de orquestração de agentes como LangChain, LlamaIndex, Agno/PhiData ou CrewAI

• Experiência com bancos de dados vetoriais para busca semântica

• Domínio avançado de técnicas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

• Experiência com integração e ajuste de prompts para LLMs como GPT-4, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, além de modelos open-source como Llama 3 e Mistral

• Experiência com serviços de IA em nuvem como AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI Service ou Google Vertex AI

• Sólidos conhecimentos em APIs RESTful, arquitetura de microserviços e conteinerização com Docker


Requisitos Desejáveis


• Experiência em LLMOps, incluindo monitoramento, rastreabilidade e avaliação de modelos em produção com ferramentas como LangSmith, Arize Phoenix ou Ragas

• Conhecimento em criação de agentes com estado e ciclos utilizando LangGraph

• Experiência prática com fine-tuning de modelos para domínios específicos

• Conhecimento em bancos de dados orientados a grafos como Neo4j para estratégias de GraphRAG

• Experiência com execução de modelos locais utilizando Ollama ou vLLM


Competências Comportamentais e Soft Skills


• Capacidade de traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em arquiteturas de agentes de IA claras e estruturadas

• Pensamento sistêmico para conectar dados, modelos, ferramentas e fluxos de decisão

• Comunicação técnica clara com áreas não técnicas, facilitando alinhamento entre tecnologia e negócio

• Postura colaborativa para atuação em times multidisciplinares

• Proatividade na identificação de melhorias técnicas e oportunidades de uso de IA

• Capacidade de mentoria e referência técnica para profissionais menos experientes

• Organização e disciplina para trabalhar com experimentação contínua sem perder rastreabilidade e governança

• Senso crítico para avaliar riscos, limitações de modelos e impactos éticos das soluções de IA


Diferenciais de Perfil


• Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta escala ou sistemas críticos

• Vivência em times de inovação, P&D ou construção de plataformas de IA do zero

• Forte preocupação com qualidade, observabilidade e confiabilidade de agentes em produção


Maiores detalhes técnicos, de contexto do produto e expectativas do cliente serão apresentados durante a entrevista técnica.

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.


FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.


We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.


What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.


Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript
  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
  • Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
  • Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
  • Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team


You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
  • Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar)
  • Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome


Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
  • Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
  • Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
  • Apple Pay integration experience


Why FlyMeOut:

  • Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
  • Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
  • Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
  • Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
  • Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction


Compensation & Terms

This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.

Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)

Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)

Health benefits: Not offered at this stage

Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis

Probation: 2 weeks

Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil


How to Apply

Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026 . In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

  • Key dashboards track the company’s most important metrics.
  • Data insights lead to better strategic decisions and faster growth .
  • The organization becomes increasingly data-driven in how it operates .

Nosso produto é uma plataforma de Agentic AI, construída sobre Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e voltada para empresas que desejam escalar conversas automatizadas e integrar canais, pagamentos e agenda em um só lugar.

A Bren é uma startup inovadora que transforma conversas em vendas, se comunicando com os clientes através do WhatsApp, 24 horas por dia. Acreditamos que equipes de vendas são essenciais para o crescimento de uma empresa, e por isso criamos soluções de automação e comunicação que aumentam a produtividade e tornam os processos mais eficientes. title: Digital Web Experience Solution Architect
description:
Digital Web Experience Solution Architect

São Paulo, Brazil/Buenos Aires, Argentina


Job Description

You were made to do this work: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimizing digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development while you help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.


In this role, you will:

  • Architect & implement scalable, secure, performant, and resilient approaches for brand websites that meet business and technical requirements.
  • Use modern CMS systems and MACH principles
  • Enable personalization, performance optimization, and measurable business outcomes
  • Comply with CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and other data privacy and regulatory requirements
  • Manage current state documents including diagrams, operational runbooks, and future-state roadmaps
  • Align digital marketing strategies within the platform architecture and guidelines.
  • Apply principles around people, process, information, and technology to design
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to translate business needs into technical specifications and architectural designs.
  • Provide Full-Stack technical leadership and guidance to development teams on modern CMS systems for building dynamic and high-performing sites, ensuring best practices are followed.
  • Continuously evaluate and recommend new tools and technologies to enhance the digital experience.
  • Lead efforts to incorporate compliance features, such as consent management and secure data handling, into the architecture.
  • Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to ensure that architectural designs align with regulatory requirements.
  • Stay current with industry trends in digital experience platforms and architecture, continuously evaluating emerging technologies and best practices to keep our brand experiences cutting-edge.
  • Provide guidance on selecting technologies and tools that also support compliance and data protection.
  • Operational Ownership to ensure uptime and reliability of all brand sites through proactive monitoring, incident management, and performance optimization including incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve architectural challenges, ensuring that solutions are scalable, secure, and performant.
  • Mentor and support other architects and engineers within the team, fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.
  • Provide Legacy Support for existing sites during migration to MACH architecture where needed.


Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital experiences.


Required expertise in:

  • Full Stack Development (Frontend: React; Backend: CMS, API-first).
  • Modern CMS solutions (headless and traditional), integration patterns, and best practices.
  • MACH architecture (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless).
  • Cloud ecosystems (Azure or AWS) and cloud-native deployments.
  • Relational database design and optimization; advanced SQL skills.
  • Strong understanding of web technologies, frameworks, and security best practices.
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience integrating Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) for unified customer profiles and personalization.
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and real-time personalization through event-driven data flows.
  • Exposure to eCommerce systems, personalization engines, or digital marketing technologies.

description:
Sobre a vaga

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

- O que você deve ter?


Principais responsabilidades


  • Atuar como Product Owner, sendo responsável pela gestão e priorização do backlog do produto.
  • Escrever e refinar estórias de usuário claras, objetivas e bem estruturadas, com critérios de aceite bem definidos.
  • Garantir alinhamento entre stakeholders de negócio e time de desenvolvimento.
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Planning, Review, Retrospective e Daily)
  • Remover impedimentos e apoiar o time na melhoria contínua.
  • Monitorar métricas de desempenho e evolução do produto.
  • Atuar em ambiente estruturado sob o framework SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework).


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência sólida em gestão ágil de projetos.
  • Vivência prática como Product Owner.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação).

  • Certificações ágeis (CSPO, PSM, SAFe Agilist, entre outras).
  • Experiência com produtos digitais ou tecnologia.


Modelo de atuação


  • 100% remoto.

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Engenheiro de Dados PL
description:
Se você gosta de desafios e quer mostrar todo o seu potencial, queremos te conhecer! A Vericode preza por um time inclusivo e repleto de diversidade, nas suas mais variadas representações. Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência!


#VemSerVericoder

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Construir, evoluir e sustentar pipelines de dados em AWS (S3, Glue, EMR, Redshift), priorizando custos, confiabilidade e observabilidade.
  • Orquestrar cargas incrementais/idempotentes no Apache Airflow (MWAA), com SLAs, retries, backfill e alertas.
  • Desenvolver jobs AWS Glue (PySpark) com tratamento de schema evolution, particionamento, tuning e uso do Glue Data Catalog.
  • Modelar camadas Bronze/Silver/Gold (Medallion) e Dimensional (Star/Snowflake) para consumo analítico.
  • Atuar em SQL Server/SSIS (on‑prem) em migrações/modernizações e integrações com o lake na AWS.
  • Escrever código limpo em Python/PySpark, YAML para DAGs/configs e praticar CI/CD (testes, code review, versionamento).
  • Colaborar com times de produto/negócio, traduzindo requisitos em soluções de dados com métricas e contratos claros.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Hard Skills (Obrigatórias)

  • AWS: S3, Glue (jobs/crawlers/Catalog), EMR (Spark), Redshift, Athena (desejável).
  • Airflow/MWAA: DAGs parametrizadas, sensors/operators AWS, backfill e monitoramento.
  • SQL ANSI: joins, window functions, CTEs, `MERGE`, tuning básico.
  • On‑prem: SQL Server (T‑SQL), SSIS (ETL).
  • Modelagem: Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) e Dimensional (Star Schema, Snowflake).
  • Python e PySpark (RDD/DataFrame API), particionamento e file sizing.
  • YAML para configs de pipelines e CI/CD (GitHub/GitLab, testes e deploy).
  • Kubernetes (básico): conceitos de pod/deployment e operação de workloads de dados (desejável).

Soft Skills (com foco em clientes e resiliência)

  • Comunicação com clientes internos: explicar soluções de dados em linguagem simples e foco em valor.
  • Resiliência operacional: manter a calma e priorizar ações durante incidentes (falhas de pipeline/SLAs).
  • Colaboração e negociação com múltiplos stakeholders (produtos, risco, compliance).
  • Mindset investigativo e resolução de problemas com documentação clara e pós‑mortem objetivo.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Trino.
  • Boas práticas de FinOps e monitoramento (CloudWatch/Prometheus).
  • Noções de segurança/mascaramento em camadas de consumo.

Benefícios:

  • Reembolso de Capacitações Técnicas: Cobertura de 100% para certificações profissionais, além de reembolso para cursos de capacitação técnica;

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Contract: PJ

Duration: Open-ended

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern cloud-native technologies while contributing to reliable, scalable systems across multi-cloud platforms.

This is a contract position , open to remote candidates located in North or South America , and will report to a Senior Manager of DevOps Engineering .


What You’ll Do

  • Participate in a regular on-call rotation , responding to incidents reliably and professionally
  • Maintain and evolve AWS cloud infrastructure , leveraging automation and infrastructure-as-code
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform
  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines , enabling agile and self-service software delivery
  • Manage and support containerized applications running on Kubernetes
  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineers and other DevOps team members to solve complex technical problems
  • Quickly absorb technical context while ramping up in a dynamic environment
  • Contribute to best practices that enhance system reliability, scalability, and performance


Minimum Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or a related role
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or GCP
  • Experience with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes
  • Experience with GitOps / CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • Exposure to logging, monitoring, and observability tools such as:
  • Datadog
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • ELK Stack
  • CloudWatch
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers working primarily in Pacific Time (PST)


Nice to Have

  • Experience developing automation or tooling using languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., Go, Python, Java, Elixir )
  • Experience building or supporting platform tooling for development, staging, or integration environments
  • Strong skills debugging performance or networking issues in Kubernetes-based applications
  • Familiarity with audit and compliance frameworks (SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS)
  • Working knowledge of UNIX/Linux operating systems
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We are currently looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join a high-performing engineering team supporting multiple global consulting engagements. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building scalable data systems, working closely with stakeholders, and delivering production-ready solutions.

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design and implement modern data architectures while supporting analytics and business decision-making.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and optimize data pipelines and distributed data systems.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows across multiple systems.
  • Deliver production-ready data solutions , from prototype to enterprise-grade systems.
  • Partner with consulting and business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Lead analytics modules and clearly communicate technical outcomes.
  • Ensure scalability, reliability, and performance of data infrastructure.


Requirements

  • Intermediate to upper-intermediate English level (B2 minimum).
  • 6+ years professional experience as a Data Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python and SQL.
  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or similar).
  • Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis, Neo4j or similar).
  • Experience working with distributed data processing (Spark, PySpark, Hadoop).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).


Nice to Have

  • Workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Data Factory, or Glue.
  • Snowflake or dimensional modeling (Star Schema).
  • Streaming technologies such as Kafka.
  • Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Azure Data Lake Storage.
  • Data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.


Benefits

  • Career development plan and continuous learning.
  • Excellent work environment and flexibility as a CONTRACTOR.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Direct hiring with us.
  • English Class.
  • Benefits platform.
  • Continuous training communities/Certs.
  • AC points (bonus).
  • National Holidays.
  • Company Events (Colombia)
  • Salary: We don't have fixed salary ranges; we tailor the economic offer based on the candidate's salary expectations. In this case, you will let us know your monthly service fee as a CONTRACTOR, and that value will be taken into account when making the offer.


If you’re looking for a place where professional growth goes hand in hand with quality of life, this opportunity is for you!

title: SAP Basis Pleno com espanhol avançado
description:
Buscamos um(a) SAP Basis Pleno  com espanhol avançado  para atuar em Managed Services  e projetos  (assessment de performance, migração e otimização). O(a) profissional atuará em ambientes RISE/SAP S/4HANA  e on‑prem/híbridos , com forte interface com Infra de Banco de Dados (HANA, Sybase, Oracle)  e Cloud (GCP, Azure, AWS) .


Responsabilidades principais:

  • Sustentação (L2/L3)  de landscapes SAP (S/4HANA, ECC, BTP/integrações, Fiori), incluindo monitoramento , incident management , problem management  e changes  (janelas programadas).
  • Operação de DB/Infra : administração e troubleshooting de SAP HANA , SAP ASE/Sybase  e Oracle  (backup/restore, tunning, roles/segurança, housekeeping, BR*Tools, etc.).
  • Cloud  (GCP/Azure/AWS): suporte a arquiteturas SAP em nuvem (compute/storage/network), conexões seguras , sizing, troubleshooting de conectividade e serviços gerenciados.
  • Projetos técnicos :
  • Performance assessment  (end‑to‑end: app/server/DB), análise de traces, memória, I/O, jobs, RFCs.
  • Migrações/Upgrades  (blue/green/rolling), patching  de kernel/DB/OS, SAP Notes  e manutenções de rotina.
  • Otimizações : melhoria contínua (ajustes de parâmetros, automações, scripts, alertas).
  • Governança e documentação : execução de checklists , RCA  (5 porquês / Ishikawa), Hiper‑care pós‑mudança , documentação reutilizável e handover.
  • Colaboração cross : interação com PMO/SDM, times de segurança, redes, vendors/hyperscalers e SAP Support (OSS).


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Espanhol avançado  (reuniões e escrita). Português : avançado. Inglês : leitura técnica.
  • Experiência comprovada  em SAP Basis  em Managed Services  (operando múltiplos clientes/landscapes).
  • DB/Infra : HANA  (Studio/Cockpit, backup/restore, performance, roles), Sybase/ASE  e Oracle  (BR*Tools, RMAN, parâmetros, troubleshooting).
  • Cloud : experiências práticas com GCP  e/ou Azure  e/ou AWS  para workloads SAP (compute, storage, networking, IAM/segurança básica, conectividade híbrida).
  • Projetos : participação ativa em assessments de performance , migrações  (incl. OS/DB/KERNEL), upgrades  e patching .
  • Conhecimento de RISE with SAP  e ecossistema atual (S/4HANA, BTP, integração com hyperscalers).
  • Vivência com monitoramento  (ST03N/ST02/SM21/DBA Cockpit, etc.), transportes  (STMS), jobs  (SM37), spool  (SP01), locks  (SM12/DB), RFC  (SM59), notas SAP  (SNOTE).
  • Boas práticas de ITSM/ITIL , segurança  (perfis/autorização básicos), documentação  e runbooks .


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações : SAP Certified Technology Associate (S/4HANA, HANA), OS/DB Migration , especializações em hyperscalers  (Azure/AWS/GCP) e segurança .
  • Experiência com SAP Web Dispatcher , SAP Router , Solution Manager/ALM , Fiori , BTP  (connectivity, destinations), Cloud Connector .
  • Automação (scripts, pipelines, Infra as Code), observability (Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana/Prometheus) e cost/performance optimization  em cloud.
  • Atuação prévia em War Rooms  e crise  (P1), com comunicação executiva.


Idiomas:

  • Espanhol Fluente


Modalidade de atuação:

  • Hibrido


Modalidade de contratação:

  • PJ

  • Conhecimento de RISE with SAP  e ecossistema atual (S/4HANA, BTP, integração com hyperscalers).
  • Vivência com monitoramento  (ST03N/ST02/SM21/DBA Cockpit, etc.), transportes  (STMS), jobs  (SM37), spool  (SP01), locks  (SM12/DB), RFC  (SM59), notas SAP  (SNOTE).
  • Boas práticas de ITSM/ITIL , segurança  (perfis/autorização básicos), documentação  e runbooks .


Diferenciais:

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Systems Engineer (Data Compression)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


***

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Systems Engineer with deep experience in compression algorithms and high-performance systems.

You will work closely with the core engineering team to help analyze, validate, optimize, and productionize advanced lossless compression technology .

The ideal candidate is both technically rigorous and intellectually curious , capable of investigating unconventional approaches while applying strong systems engineering discipline.


What you'll work on

  • Designing and optimizing lossless compression techniques
  • Evaluating compression performance across different datasets
  • Improving throughput, compression ratio, and memory efficiency
  • Benchmarking and profiling performance-critical systems
  • Building high-performance libraries and services
  • Collaborating with engineers to productionize compression technology

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong programming skills in C++, Rust, C, or other systems languages
  • Experience with performance optimization and profiling
  • Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures
  • Experience building high-performance systems or infrastructure
  • Comfortable working with confidential technology under NDA
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills

Nice to have

  • Experience with compression algorithms (LZ, Zstd, Huffman, Brotli, etc.)
  • Background in storage systems, distributed systems, or databases
  • Experience working at cloud providers or infrastructure companies
  • Experience with benchmarking or systems performance testing
  • Familiarity with AI / GenAI development tools


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through .

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: ANALISTA DE SISTEMAS SR [ANALYTICS ENGINEER - DATABRICKS]
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra.


Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 160 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos. Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.



Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos buscando uma pessoa com energia, senso de dono e muita vontade de construir para atuar como protagonista na evolução do nosso ecossistema moderno de dados.

Essa posição terá papel fundamental na consolidação e evolução da arquitetura analítica baseada em Databricks e Microsoft Fabric, garantindo integração eficiente entre engenharia, modelagem e consumo estratégico de dados.

Se você gosta de transformar ambientes complexos em soluções organizadas, escaláveis e orientadas a negócio, essa oportunidade é para você.



Principais responsabilidades


· Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados no Databricks, garantindo performance, escalabilidade e confiabilidade.

· Estruturar e evoluir arquiteturas Lakehouse (bronze, silver, gold).

· Atuar na construção e evolução do ambiente Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Lakehouse, Warehouse e integração com Power BI).

· Modelar dados para consumo analítico e estratégico.

· Desenvolver e otimizar modelos semânticos, garantindo governança, performance e clareza executiva.

· Integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (Oracle, SQL Server e outras).

· Garantir qualidade, padronização, rastreabilidade e documentação técnica.

· Atuar próximo às áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em soluções escaláveis.

· Propor melhorias contínuas na arquitetura e processos de dados.



Requisitos Técnicos


· Experiência sólida com Databricks (engenharia de dados, notebooks, jobs, otimização, espelhamento de dados, governança).

· Experiência com Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, pipelines, integração, modelagem, DAX, performance).

· Domínio de SQL avançado.

· Experiência com Python (PySpark).

· Conhecimento em modelagem dimensional e analítica.

· Conhecimento em boas práticas de qualidade e governança de dados.


Diferenciais:


· Experiência com CI/CD para dados.

· Experiência com Power BI (Dataviz).

· Experiência com governança (catálogo, lineage, CDEs).

· Vivência em ambientes corporativos de grande porte.

· Experiência com arquitetura orientada a produtos de dados.



CLT - 100% REMOTO (HÍBRIDO SE FOR DA REGIÃO DE BOITUVA/SP)



✅ Benefícios que fazem a diferença:

title: Product Owner
description:
Sobre a vaga


Código da vaga: 58541 e 58598


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Principais responsabilidades


  • Atuar como Product Owner, sendo responsável pela gestão e priorização do backlog do produto.
  • Escrever e refinar estórias de usuário claras, objetivas e bem estruturadas, com critérios de aceite bem definidos.
  • Garantir alinhamento entre stakeholders de negócio e time de desenvolvimento.
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Planning, Review, Retrospective e Daily)
  • Remover impedimentos e apoiar o time na melhoria contínua.
  • Monitorar métricas de desempenho e evolução do produto.
  • Atuar em ambiente estruturado sob o framework SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework).


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência sólida em gestão ágil de projetos.
  • Vivência prática como Product Owner.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação).
  • Excelente comunicação escrita, especialmente para elaboração de: estórias de usuário, critérios de aceite e documentação funcional.


Diferenciais


  • Conhecimento e atuação em ambientes com SAFe.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSPO, PSM, SAFe Agilist, entre outras).
  • Experiência com produtos digitais ou tecnologia.


Modelo de atuação


  • 100% remoto.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

  • Desenvolver jobs AWS Glue (PySpark) com tratamento de schema evolution, particionamento, tuning e uso do Glue Data Catalog.
  • Modelar camadas Bronze/Silver/Gold (Medallion) e Dimensional (Star/Snowflake) para consumo analítico.
  • Atuar em SQL Server/SSIS (on‑prem) em migrações/modernizações e integrações com o lake na AWS.
  • Escrever código limpo em Python/PySpark, YAML para DAGs/configs e praticar CI/CD (testes, code review, versionamento).

Requisitos e qualificações:

Hard Skills (Obrigatórias)

  • AWS: S3, Glue (jobs/crawlers/Catalog), EMR (Spark), Redshift, Athena (desejável).

  • SQL ANSI: joins, window functions, CTEs, `MERGE`, tuning básico.

  • Python e PySpark (RDD/DataFrame API), particionamento e file sizing.
  • YAML para configs de pipelines e CI/CD (GitHub/GitLab, testes e deploy).

  • Resiliência operacional: manter a calma e priorizar ações durante incidentes (falhas de pipeline/SLAs).
  • Colaboração e negociação com múltiplos stakeholders (produtos, risco, compliance).
  • Mindset investigativo e resolução de problemas com documentação clara e pós‑mortem objetivo.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Trino.
  • Boas práticas de FinOps e monitoramento (CloudWatch/Prometheus).
  • Noções de segurança/mascaramento em camadas de consumo.

Benefícios:

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner
